'''Marshall Talbot''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[1999 Endor Regionals]] on 4 September 1999 with [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations with Imperial Arrest Order]], according to Douglas Harvilla's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d31">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-05-endor-regional-championship-9-4-99d31/ endor-regional-championship-9-4-99], DeckTech (Douglas "Douglas" Harvilla, 5 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-05-endor-regional-championship-9-4-99d31/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
